non_claims: Hydroxyl and methoxyl positions beyond the hypothesis scaffold are not resolved

notes: Flavan-3-ol aglycone [M+H]+: the A-ring ion C7H7O3+ of a C ring without 4-keto with one B-ring ion (1,2B+ or 1,4B+), from Tsimogiannis 2007; the nominal-only C8H7O3+ marker of Jiang 2024 is reported as an upgrade only.

competitors.note: 3-hydroxyphloretin shares C15H14O6 with catechin; alpha cleavage of its dihydrocaffeoyl unit could give the 1,2B+ and 1,4B+ formulas, and its protonated trihydroxyacetophenone unit minus H2O the upgrade formula C8H7O3+ (inference, not from a source)
